title: What Would Have Happened: Past Counterfactuals
goal: Use si with hubiera and the past participle, and habría with the past participle, to reason about a past that did not happen.

items: I can use si hubiera and habría with a past participle to say what would have happened.
I can put the result clause first, and use si no hubiera sido por to name what made the difference.
I can use the new words for causes and turning points.
